home.hero_p1: In the light frozen inside amber, see the breath of the forest.
home.hero_p2: In the rising smoke of incense, hear the stillness of the mountains.
home.hero_p3: Our handcraft keeps nature beside you — translucent, breathing room, Eastern zen.
home.story_p1: Each piece begins with a conversation in the forest. From Baltic amber to Yunnan agarwood, from Malaysian rattan to the spice routes of the Middle East — we travel far to bring nature's breath to you.
home.story_p2: The forest is not the backdrop. It is the protagonist. Wear one amber, light one incense — the forest lives.
home.footer_tagline: Forest-rooted handcraft brand · Greater SEA + Middle East · four locales
